- [List access review campaigns](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getaccessreviewscampaigns.md): <p>           Lists access review campaign executions bucketed by state. Completed and archived executions include the           file IDs of their auto-generated report ZIPs (per-app CSVs, and per-app PDFs), which can be downloaded via           the <code>GET /files/{id}/download</code> endpoint. A null file ID on a completed execution means the report           is still being generated — retry shortly. Archived executions hold partial reports for campaigns that were           cancelled or archived before completion. <code>completedExecutions</code> includes runs concluded early by an admin.         </p>         <p>           Ordering: every bucket is newest-first. Each bucket returns at most <code>limit</code> executions           (default 100, max 1000) — a bucket holding exactly <code>limit</code> items may have older ones beyond it;           raise <code>limit</code> to fetch deeper history. Use <code>completedAfter</code> to poll for newly completed           executions — it returns only executions whose <code>completionTime</code> is strictly after the given timestamp.         </p>         <p>Example — download the latest completed campaign report:</p>         <code class="hljs">curl -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/accessReviews/campaigns?completedAfter=2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"</code>         <hr />         <code class="hljs">curl -L -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" -o report.zip "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/files/{REPORT_ZIP_FILE_ID}/download"</code> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 600 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Create user anonymization request](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postanonymizerequest.md): <p>Create new user anonymization request.</p>       <div>       <code>email</code>       the email that should be anonymized.</p>       <code>fields</code>        the user fields to anonymized.</p>       </div> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List access request policies](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getappcatalogaccessrequestpolicies.md): Returns the organization’s access request policies.<br/><br/>Use the `fields` query parameter to choose which fields to return — e.g. `fields=id,name,app,approvalFlow,eligibilityGroups,accessDurationsConfig`.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 60 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List access request policies eligible for a user](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getappcatalogaccessrequestpolicieseligible.md): Returns the access request policies the specified user is eligible to request for the given app.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 60 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Request access on user behalf](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postappcatalogaccessrequestpoliciesidaccessrequestpolicytrigger.md): Triggers an access request for the specified policy on behalf of the user identified by `userEmail`.<br/><br/>Eligibility is enforced: the request fails with 400 NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_POLICY if the user is not a member of the policy’s eligibility groups.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 60 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Bulk request access on user behalf](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postappcatalogaccessrequestpoliciestrigger.md): Triggers an access request for each of the specified policies on behalf of the user identified by `userEmail`.<br/><br/>Each policy is processed independently, so some may succeed while others are rejected.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 30 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List app fields](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getappsfields.md): Returns a list of app fields with their options.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Create a new field](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postappsfields.md): Create a new app field<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 50 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Delete field](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/deleteappsfieldsidfield.md): Delete app field<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 50 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List app fields metadata](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getappsmetadata.md): List apps fields (predefined and custom).<br/><br/>The list of options for dropdown and multi dropdown fields is not provided by this API.<br/><br/>You can search by field name or key.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Update field](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/putappsfieldsidfield.md): Update app field<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 50 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List application users](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getappsidappusers.md): <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 600 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List apps](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getapps.md): Returns a list of apps used in the organization.<br/><br/><hr /><br/><br/>Filtering is available via the documented query parameters below and by [custom application fields](https://app.toriihq.com/team/settings/appDetails).<br/><br/>Example:<br/><br/>```GET /apps?fields=id,name,myCustomField&state=discovered&myCustomField=true```<br/><br/>The above example returns a list of applications that are in `discovered` state and `myCustomField` is true. Each application object will contain the `id`, `name` and `myCustomField` fields.<br/><br/>Use `includeLicenses=true` to include aggregated license summary for each app.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Add app](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postapps.md): <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Search apps](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getappssearch.md): Returns a list of apps from Torii's catalog with name that contains q<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get app](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getappsidapp.md): Returns a specific app.<br/><br/><hr /><br/><br/>Example:<br/><br/>```GET /apps/1?fields=id,name,myCustomField&state=discovered&myCustomField=true```<br/><br/>The above example returns app with id=1. Each application object will contain the `id`, `name` and `myCustomField` fields.<br/><br/>Use `includeLicenses=true` to include aggregated license summary.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 400 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Update app](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/putappsidapp.md): Update app fields including all custom fields defined via [custom Application Details](https://app.toriihq.com/team/settings/appDetails)<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Create app](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postappscustom.md): <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Match apps](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postappsmatch.md): Try to match a list of apps by their name<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get similar apps](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getappssimilar.md): Returns apps in the organization catalog that are similar to a given app.<br/><br/>The source app is identified by its `idApp`.<br/><br/>Returns all similar apps (the set is naturally bounded, so there is no pagination).<br/><br/>An app with no similar apps returns `200` with an empty `similarApps` array. A missing app returns `404`.<br/><br/><p><ul><li>Rate limit: 400 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get admin audit logs](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getaudit.md): The Audit Log API allows the user to pull Audit Log events happening in the organization account.               <br>The API is sorted based on <code>creationTime</code> and supports pagination. The default sort order is descending.               <br>Filtering is possible using the following attributes: <code>entity</code>, <code>startTime</code>, <code>endTime</code>               <br>If you encounter an HTTP 502 error, ensure that gzip compression is enabled (Accept-Encoding: gzip), if possible. Additionally, try reducing the <code>size</code> parameter to help resolve the issue. <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List contracts](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getcontracts.md): Returns a list of contracts in the organization.<br/><br/><hr />This endpoint has two versions: 1.0 and 1.1. The default version is 1.0 for API keys created before Aug 1st 2026 and 1.1 for keys created after Aug 1st 2026. You can specify the version via the `X-API-Version` header to override.<hr /><br/><br/><h3>Filtering</h3><br/><br/>Filter contracts by passing each field as its own query parameter. Multiple filters are combined with AND. Values are matched by exact equality — partial match, range, and comparator operators are not supported on this endpoint.<br/><br/>Supported filter fields: `id`, `idApp`, `createdBy`, `status`, and any [custom contract field](https://app.toriihq.com/team/settings/contractDetails) system key.<br/><br/>Example:<br/><br/>```GET /contracts?fields=id,name,idApp,status,myCustomField&status=active&idApp=123&myCustomField=true```<br/><br/>The above returns contracts where `status=active` AND `idApp=123` AND `myCustomField=true`.<br/><br/><hr />Query params are different per version:<br/><br/><table><thead><tr><th>Query param</th><th>Supported in version</th><th>Description</th><th>Default value</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>fields</td><td>v1.0, v1.1</td><td>List of fields to return for each contract</td><td>(no value)</td></tr><tr><td>q</td><td>v1.1 only</td><td>The query to search</td><td>(no value)</td></tr><tr><td>sort</td><td>v1.1 only</td><td>Sort order</td><td>(no value)</td></tr><tr><td>size</td><td>v1.1 only</td><td>Number of results to return (max: 1000)</td><td>1000</td></tr><tr><td>cursor</td><td>v1.1 only</td><td>Cursor for pagination</td><td>(no value)</td></tr><tr><td>aggs</td><td>v1.1 only</td><td>Aggregation configuration</td><td>(no value)</td></tr><tr><td>filters</td><td>v1.1 only</td><td>The filters to apply (JSON string)</td><td>(no value)</td></tr></tbody></table><br/><br/><h3>Multi-currency support</h3><br/><br/>All currency fields are returned in their original amounts based on the contract currency. To get the contract currency, add `currency` to `fields`.<br/><br/>Example:<br/><br/>```GET /contracts?fields=id,name,amount,currency```<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Create contract](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postcontracts.md): Creates a new contract.<br/><br/>The request body must contain the name, idApp, and status of the contract.<br/><br/>Dates should be sent in ISOString format. Example: "2022-02-03"<br/><br/>Currency fields (e.g., `amount`) can be numbers (`"amount": 1500`, uses org default currency) or objects to set a different currency: `"amount": { "value": 23000000, "currency": "EUR" }`. Cannot set `currency` as a top-level field.<br/><br/>Optional `lineItems` are created with the contract (each needs a `description`; `quantity`, `pricePerUnit`, `totalCost`, `currency`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `sku` and the other value fields are optional; row ids and license mapping cannot be set here). Read them back with `GET /contracts/{idContract}?fields=lineItems`.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get contract](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getcontractsidcontract.md): Returns a single contract.<br/><br/>Add `lineItems` to `fields` to include the contract's line items (products / SKUs on the order) in the response; they are not returned otherwise, and the list endpoint never returns them. Example: ```GET /contracts/123?fields=id,name,lineItems```<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 800 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Delete contract](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/deletecontractsidcontract.md): <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Update contract](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/putcontractsidcontract.md): Updates an existing contract.<br/><br/>Currency fields (e.g., `amount`) can be numbers (`"amount": 1500`, uses org default currency) or objects to set a different currency: `"amount": { "value": 23000000, "currency": "EUR" }`. Cannot set `currency` as a top-level field.<br/><br/>Optional `lineItems` are **appended** to the contract's existing line items (each needs a `description`; the same optional value fields as on create). Items cannot carry an `id` (400), existing items are never modified or removed here, and omitting `lineItems` leaves them unchanged. Removing a line item is done in the Torii web app. Read them back with `GET /contracts/{idContract}?fields=lineItems`.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 400 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List contract fields](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getcontractsfields.md): Returns a list of contract fields with their options.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List contract fields metadata](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getcontractsmetadata.md): List contract fields (predefined and custom).<br/><br/>The list of options for dropdown and multi dropdown fields is not provided by this API.<br/><br/>You can search by field name or key.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get extension settings](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getextensionsettings.md): Returns the browser extension configuration: dlp (data loss prevention), blockedSites, and usersFilter.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Update extension settings](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/putextensionsettings.md): Updates the browser extension configuration. Each provided section (dlp, blockedSites, usersFilter) is fully replaced; omitted sections are unchanged. blockedSites.sites supports up to 5000 sites.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 50 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get parameters for uploading files](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getfilesurl.md): <div><strong>This API is part of a series of API calls you need to make to upload a file to our system.</strong></div>         <details>           <summary>             Click here to see the APIs alongside code examples using cURL           </summary>           <ol>             <li>               <details>                 <summary>                   This API. It returns a URL (used in step #2) and the file's path (used in step #3):                                 </summary>                 <code class="hljs">curl -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/files/url?name={FILE_NAME}&type={CONTENT_TYPE}"</code>                 <hr />                 <code class="hljs">curl -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/files/url?name=my_file.json&type=text/csv"</code>               </details>             </li>             <li>               <details>                 <summary>                   Use the URL returned to upload the file directly to S3:                 </summary>                 <code class="hljs">curl -H "Content-Type: {CONTENT_TYPE}" --data-binary @'PATH/TO/YOUR/FILE' -X PUT "{S3_URL}"</code>                 <hr />                 <code class="hljs">curl -H "Content-Type: text/csv" --data-binary @'~/Downloads/my_file.json' -X PUT "{S3_URL}"</code>               </details>             </li>             <li>               <details>                 <summary>                   Look for the 'Store file information in DB' API or use the following code snippet:                 </summary>                 <code class="hljs">curl -d '{"path":"{FILE_PATH}","type":"{FILE_TYPE}"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/files"</code>                 <hr />                 <code class="hljs">curl -d '{"path":"1629889604893/my_file.json","type":"expenseReport"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/files"</code>               </details>             </li>           </ol>         </details> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get file information](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getfilesid.md): <p>Use the following code snippet to get the information of a file that was uploaded to Torii</p>         <code class="hljs">curl -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/files/{FILE_ID}"</code>         <hr />         <code class="hljs">curl -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/files/1000"</code> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 600 requests per minute</li></ul></p>

- [Upload file (up to 3MB)](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postfilesupload.md): <p>           This API allows to upload small files (up to 3MB). To upload larger files, see the <code>GET /files/url</code> endpoint.           <br />           <br />           Supported files: .csv, .xls, .xlsx, .pdf, .doc, .docx, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .xml, .json, .zip, .txt, .md, .tsv, .webp, .heic.         </p> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Sync custom integration](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/putservicessynccustom.md): <div>Use the following code snippet to validate an uploaded data file and sync a custom integration</div>         <code class="hljs">curl -X PUT -d '{"idFile":"{FILE_ID}", "idAppAccount": "{APP_ACCOUNT_ID}"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/services/sync/custom"</code>         <ul>           <li>The uploaded file must be a JSON file.</li>           <li>Before uploading a file using <a href="#operation--files-url-get">File upload API</a>, follow the file schema.</li>           <li>File type is "customIntegrationData".</li>           <li>Only one sync can run at a time, a 409 error code will be returned if there's an attempt to run more than one sync at a time.</li>         </ul>         <details>           <summary>File schema</summary>           Default values are marked in <span style="color:red;">red</span>           <ol>             <li>users - Array [required] - Must have at least 1 valid user</li>             <div>User object:</div>             <ul>                 <li>id - String [optional] - The unique identifier of a user in the application</li>                 <li>email - String [required]</li>                 <li>firstName - String [optional]</li>                 <li>lastName - String [optional]</li>                 <li>status - Enum (<span style="color:red;">active</span>/deleted ) [optional] - The status of the user in Torii. Only active users are displayed as users of the application</li>                 <li>externalStatus - String [optional] - The status of the user as it appears on the application’s site</li>                 <li>roles - String[] [optional]</li>                 <li>lastUsedDate - Date [optional] - ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD)</li>             </ul>             <li>licenses - Array [optional]</li>             <div>License object:</div>             <ul>                <li>name - String [required]</li>                <li>unassignedAmount - Number [optional] - Number of licenses that are not assigned to users</li>                <li>users - Array [optional]</li>                <div>License user object:</div>                <ul>                   <li>email - String [required] - user's email</li>                   <li>licenseStatus - Enum ( active/inactive/deleted ) [optional] - If not provided, will be defined by user status</li>                </ul>                <li>pricePerUser - Number [optional] - should be sent in cents (will be saved in the organization's display currency) </li>             <ul>           </ol>         </details>         <details>           <summary>File example</summary> <pre>  {   "users": [     {       "id: "15893",       "email": "adam@example.com",       "firstName": "Adam",       "lastName": "Test",       "status": "active",       "externalStatus": "Active",       "roles": ["Admin", "Super admin"],       "lastUsedDate": "2021-07-05T20:43:14Z"     },     {       "id": "39471",       "email": "tony@example.com",       "firstName": "Tony",       "lastName": "Example",       "status": "active",       "externalStatus": "Deactivated",       "roles": ["Member"],       "lastUsedDate": "2021-05-05T14:43:14Z"     }   ],   "licenses": [     {       "name": "Pro",       "unassignedAmount": 10,       "users": [         {           "email": "adam@example.com",           "licenseStatus": "active"         }       ],       "pricePerUser": 15000     },     {       "name": "Basic",       "unassignedAmount": 5,       "users": [],       "pricePerUser": 0     },     {       "name": "Corp",       "unassignedAmount": 20,       "users": [         {           "email": "tony@example.com",           "licenseStatus": "inactive"         }       ],       "pricePerUser": 20000     }   ] }</pre> </details> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Sync Gluu custom integration](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/putservicessyncgluu.md): <div>Use the following code snippet to sync your Gluu integration</div>         <code class="hljs">curl -X PUT -d '{"idFile":"{FILE_ID}", "idAppAccount": "{APP_ACCOUNT_ID}"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/services/sync/gluu"</code>         <ul>           <li>The uploaded file must be a CSV file.</li>           <li>In order to upload the file use the  <a href="#operation--files-url-get">File upload API</a></li>           <li>File type is "customIntegrationData".</li>         </ul> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Create a custom integration account](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postservicescustom.md): Provisions a new custom integration account for the given app and returns its id.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 50 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get organization](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getorgsmy.md): Returns the organization profile. <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get parse request](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getparsingsid.md): <p>Use the following code snippet to get the information of a parse request</p>         <code class="hljs">curl -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/parsings/{PARSING_ID}"</code>         <div>Request status will be one of the following</div>         <ul>           <li><strong>parsing_in_progress</strong> - Request is in progress</li>           <li><strong>parsed_successfully</strong> - Request has been parsed successfully</li>           <li><strong>parsing_failed</strong> - Request has been failed to parse</li>         </ul> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 800 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Parse automatically](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/putparsingsautomatic.md): <p>Use the following code snippet to parse an expense file with automatic column matching:</p>         <code class="hljs">curl -X PUT -d '{"idFile":"{FILE_ID}"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/parsings/automatic"</code>         <hr />         <h3>IMPORTANT</h3>         <p><strong>After sending a parse request, make sure to poll <code>https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/parsings/{PARSING_ID}</code> to verify that the request was successful</strong></p> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Parse manually](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/putparsingsmanual.md): <div>Use the following code snippet to parse an expense file with manual column matching:</div>         <code class="hljs">curl -X PUT -d '{"parseConfig":{"idFile":"{FILE_ID}","transactionDateColumn":"A","descriptionColumn":"B", "amountColumn":"C", "dateFormat": "DD/MM/YYYY", "currencyColumn":"D"}}' -H "Authorization: Bearer API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" "https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/parsings/manual"</code>         <ul>           <li>Date format must be identical for all transactions</li>           <li>             You should only send one of these parameters: <i>currencyColumn</i> or <i>currency</i>             <div>Use <mark>currency</mark> when all the transactions are of the same currency</div>             <div>Use <mark>currencyColumn</mark> when the transactions are of different currencies</div>           </li>         </ul>         <hr />         <h3>IMPORTANT</h3>         <p><strong>After sending a parse request, make sure to poll <code>https://api.toriihq.com/v1.0/parsings/{PARSING_ID}</code> to verify that the request was successful</strong></p> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List plugin fields](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getpluginsidpluginfields.md): Returns a list of plugin fields with their associated idField.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Create plugin](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postplugins.md): <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Generate an API key for a private plugin](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postpluginsuuidpluginapikey.md): This API is only available for private plugins installed on the organization. This will revoke any previous API keys associated with the plugin. <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Delete plugin](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/deletepluginsuuidplugin.md): <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Update plugin (publish new version)](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/putpluginsuuidplugin.md): <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List roles](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getroles.md): Returns the list of roles in the organization <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List Resource Types](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getscimv2resourcetypes.md): Returns the available resource types in the SCIM API. <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List Schemas](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getscimv2schemas.md): Returns the available resource types schemas, with attributes information. <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get Service Provider Configuration](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getscimv2serviceproviderconfig.md): Returns Torii's SCIM Configuration. <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List Users](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getscimv2users.md): Retrieve all the active users in Torii. <br>Active users can log in to Torii and/or the App Catalog and/or the Browser Extension. <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Create User](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postscimv2users.md): Create a Torii user. <p><ul><li>Torii users can log in to Torii and/or the App Catalog and/or the Browser Extension.</li><li>The user's app permissions are determined according to the user's role, represented by the <code>userType</code> attribute.</li><li>The user can be created as <b>Active</b> or <b>Inactive</b>, according to the <code>active</code> attribute.</li><li>Only active users can log in to Torii apps.</li></ul></p> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get User By ID](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getscimv2usersiduser.md): Returns the user associated with the user's ID. <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 400 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Delete User](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/deletescimv2usersiduser.md): Delete Torii user<p><ul><li>If the user is the last admin in the org, the user cannot be deleted.</li></ul></p> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Update User (PUT)](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/putscimv2usersiduser.md): Update Torii user<p><ul><li>Only active users can be updated.</li><li>The user's <code>userName</code> (email address) cannot be updated.</li><li>To deactivate a user, use <code>active: false</code></li><li>Use the <code>POST</code> method to reactivate inactive users.</li><li>If the user is the last admin in the org, you cannot update his role.</li></p> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Update user (PATCH)](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/patchscimv2usersiduser.md): Update Torii user<p><ul><li>The user's <code>userName</code> (email address) cannot be updated.</li><li>To deactivate a user, use <code>active: false</code></li><li>If the user is the last admin in the org, you cannot update his role.</li></p><a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7644#section-3.5.2">For more information.</a> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List transactions](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/gettransactions.md): Returns recognized (mapped) expense transactions by default.<br/><br/>`amount` is an object: `value`/`currency` are the original transaction amount; `convertedValue` is that amount in the organization display currency. Values are in minor currency units (e.g., cents).<br/><br/>Cursor-paginated: pass `size` for the page size and the returned `nextCursor` as `cursor` for the next page.<br/><br/>Sort with `sort=<field>:asc|desc`; sorting by `amount` uses the display-currency converted value. See `transactionSortSchema` for the sortable fields.<br/><br/>Bound a period with `filters` on `transactionDate`, using the `dayOnOrAfter` / `dayOnOrBefore` operators — they match whole days, so a time component in the value is ignored rather than cutting that day short.<br/><br/>Use `aggs` for spend totals and breakdowns instead of paging through transactions and summing them client-side. Pair it with a `transactionDate` filter to bound the period and `size=1` to keep the response compact — the numbers come back in `aggregations`.<br/><br/>Example — spend per app for 2026 year-to-date (`aggs` and `filters` are JSON and must be URL-encoded; shown decoded here for readability):<br/><br/>```GET /transactions?size=1&filters=[{"key":"transactionDate","op":"dayOnOrAfter","value":"2026-01-01"},{"key":"transactionDate","op":"dayOnOrBefore","value":"2026-08-31"}]&aggs={"field":"appName","aggregationType":"groupBy","options":{"size":100,"sort":{"order":"desc","aggFunc":"sum","field":"amount"}},"aggs":[{"field":"amount","aggregationType":"metric","options":{"metricFunction":"sum"}}]}```<br/><br/>Reading the result — in a `groupBy` bucket, `value` is the **transaction count**, not the amount. The metric you asked for is in the bucket's own `aggregations`: `[{"key":"slack","value":37,"aggregations":{"amount":106414875}}]` means 37 transactions totalling 1064148.75 in display currency. Reading `value` as money is the most common way to get this wrong.<br/><br/>A trailing `{"key":"Other"}` bucket rolls up everything past `options.size` (max 100) and carries no `aggregations` — skip it or widen the window.<br/><br/>Aggregated amounts are in the organization display currency, in minor units (cents). `appName` group keys are lower-cased (the field is indexed with a lowercase normalizer); group by `idApp` instead when you need the exact name casing.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List transactions metadata](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/gettransactionsmetadata.md): Returns the transaction fields<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Update transaction](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/puttransactionsidtransaction.md): Set `idApp` to match a transaction to an app (this marks it `mapped`); pass `idApp: null` to unmatch.<br/><br/>Set `mappingStatus: "archived"` to archive a transaction. Archived transactions are not returned by `GET /transactions`.<br/><br/>To unmatch and reset the status, send both `idApp: null` and `mappingStatus: "unknown"`.<br/><br/>`amount.value` is in minor currency units (e.g., cents) and overrides the original amount; the currency is unchanged.<br/><br/>`transactionDate` overrides the transaction date (ISO 8601, e.g. `2022-02-03`).<br/><br/>Returns only the fields affected by the update (`id`, `idApp`, `mappingStatus`, `transactionDate`).<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List user applications](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getusersiduserapps.md): Returns list of all applications used by the user.<br/><br/>Filtering is available via the documented query parameters below and by [custom application fields](https://app.toriihq.com/team/settings/appDetails).<br/><br/>Multi Currency Support: The field `annualCost` is returned in the license currency. To retrieve the license currency, `currency` can be added to fields. Additionally, adding `annualCostConverted` will return the amount based on the organization's chosen display currency.<br/><br/>Example:<br/><br/>```GET /users/12345/apps?fields=id,name,myCustomField&state=discovered&myCustomField=true```<br/><br/>The above example returns a list of user applications for the user 12345. Only applications that are in `discovered` state and `myCustomField` is true will be returned. Each application object will contain the `id`, `name` and `myCustomField` fields.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 800 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get user application](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getusersiduserappsidapp.md): Returns the user application. <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 800 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Update user application](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/putusersiduserappsidapp.md): Updates the user application with fields sent in the request body. <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List user custom fields](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getusersfields.md): List user custom fields for connected integrations<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List user fields metadata](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getusersmetadata.md): List user fields (predefined and custom).<br/><br/>The list of options for dropdown and multi dropdown fields is not provided by this API.<br/><br/>You can search by field name or key.<br/><br/> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List users](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getusers.md): <p>Returns a list of users in the organization. Filtering is available via query parameters.</p> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get user](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getusersiduser.md): <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 800 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Update user](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/putusersiduser.md): Updates the user with fields sent in the request body. <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get action execution logs](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getworkflowsactionexecutions.md): <p>Returns a list of any action executions in the organization, sorted by         <code>creationTime</code> in descending order. Pagination is supported.</p>         <div>         Filtering is possible using the following attributes:</p>         <code>idActionApp</code>         <br />         <code>idActionUser</code>         </div> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 500 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get workflows edit history](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getworkflowsaudit.md): Returns a list of workflows edit history <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Run App Access Request Policy](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postappcatalogtriggerappaccessrequestpolicy.md): <p>Triggers an App Access Request Policy. In case the app has a valid Custom Policy configured - that Custom Policy will be executed. Otherwise, the Default Access Request Policy will be executed.</p> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Run workflow](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/postworkflowsidworkflowtrigger.md): <p>Triggers a workflow.</p>     <div>     <code>triggerUserEmail</code>     should be provided for the following workflow triggers: "User meets criteria", "User joins", "User left", "Closed app in use", "License not in use" and "App event".</p>     <code>triggerAppId</code>     should be provided for the following workflow triggers: "Application meets criteria", "Closed app in use" and "New app discovered".</p>     <code>triggerContractId</code>     should be provided for the following workflow triggers: "Contract meets criteria".</p>     <code>triggerLicenseName</code> and <code>triggerLicenseAppId</code>     should be provided for the following workflow triggers: "License not in use".</p>     </div> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 100 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [List workflows](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getworkflows.md): <p>Returns workflows for the organization, filtered by the <code>type</code> query param         (defaults to <code>regular</code>). Each workflow includes a <code>version</code> field         indicating its schema version.</p> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 500 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
- [Get workflow](https://developers.toriihq.com/reference/getworkflowsidworkflow.md): <p>Returns a single regular workflow. Response includes a <code>version</code> field indicating its schema version.</p> <p><ul><li>Rate limit: 200 requests per minute</li></ul></p>
